seo.title: ROVI: the O&M trainer dashboard | Touchpulse
seo.description: ROVI is the web dashboard for Orientation and Mobility trainers. Create custom training routes, record spoken instructions, assign routes to clients, and track progress from one place.

sections.headline: Your routes. Your voice. In your client's ear.
sections.subheadline: ROVI is the web dashboard where O&M trainers build custom training routes, record instructions at each point, and assign them directly to clients. Clients walk the route in the Tiera app with the trainer's guidance spoken at the exact right moments.
sections.image_alt: A trainer reviewing and preparing a navigation route

sections.text: Today, O&M training relies on paper notes, memorised scripts, and walking the route in person. None of that travels with the client. ROVI does.

steps.title: Sign in with your organisation code
steps.body: Trainers access the dashboard with an organisation short code and their work email. No per-user passwords, no IT ticket, no setup delay. The session stays active for 24 hours.

steps.title: Plan the route
steps.body: Type a start and end address. The system draws a candidate path on an interactive map. Drag, insert, or delete any point to route around hazards the engine does not know about: a damaged kerb, a missing tactile strip, the safe crossing two metres further down.

steps.title: Add instructions at specific points
steps.body: Place text annotations at exact positions along the route. These become spoken guidance delivered to the client at precisely the right moment: 'At the second tactile strip, the kerb drops. Step down carefully.' The client hears this in their language using the same TTS pipeline as the rest of Tiera.

steps.title: Assign to your clients
steps.body: Select clients from the planner sidebar. Tick the ones the route is for. Assignment and planning happen on the same screen. The client receives a push notification the moment the route is assigned.

steps.title: Auto-save on every edit
steps.body: There is no Save button. Every change commits in under one second. Trainers cannot lose work. Routes are ready to use the moment they are built.

sections.heading: What the client experiences
sections.body: When a trainer assigns a route, the client's Tiera app receives a push notification naming the trainer's organisation. A dedicated Custom Routes tab lists every assigned route, sorted by most recent. The client follows turn-by-turn navigation along the trainer's exact path, with the trainer's instructions spoken at the exact moments they marked. The same TTS pipeline, in 20 languages, VoiceOver and TalkBack safe throughout.
sections.callout: The trainer's craft becomes a route that walks with the client, repeatedly, without the trainer being present.

seo.title: Pathway: teleassistance for O&M organisations | Touchpulse
seo.description: Pathway is the operator dashboard that connects sighted support staff to blind and low-vision clients in real time. Staff it with your own team or use Touchpulse managed operators at 50p per minute.

sections.headline: A person on the line when the route is not enough
sections.subheadline: Tiera's AI navigation gets clients from A to B most of the time. Pathway is the human layer for the moments it cannot: a construction barrier, a confusing intersection, an address sign that needs reading. One tap connects the client to a sighted operator who sees exactly what they see.
sections.image_alt: A teleoperator at a support station ready to assist a client

sections.text: Accessibility helplines today are phone-only, low context, and slow to resolve. Pathway operators see the same world the client is in: same map, same route, same camera feed. Before the client finishes their sentence.

steps.title: The client calls for help
steps.body: A prominent call button on the Tiera home screen is reachable by touch or by voice. The client says 'call teleassistance' or taps the button. The app confirms out loud, places them in queue, and reads back the estimated wait time.

steps.title: The operator receives the call
steps.body: The Pathway dashboard shows an incoming call modal with the client's avatar, name, and email. The operator accepts. Before they say a word, they already see the client's live camera feed, their map position, their active route, their next navigation instruction, and their AI chat history.

steps.title: The operator talks them through it
steps.body: Full-duplex audio via LiveKit at sub-second latency. The operator's microphone is live the moment they accept. No fumbling, no delay. The typical resolution takes 30 to 90 seconds.

steps.title: Navigation resumes
steps.body: The operator hangs up. The system tears down cleanly. The client's route picks back up from exactly where it left off. There is no disruption to their journey.

sections.heading: What the operator sees
sections.body: Pathway gives operators everything they need before the client speaks. Every call is tied to a named operator, creating a complete audit chain for reporting and safeguarding. The operator dashboard includes:

items.title: Live camera feed
items.body: The operator sees the client's phone camera in real time. They can spot the barrier, read the sign, or identify the landmark the client cannot.

items.title: Live map position and route overlay
items.body: The client's current GPS position is shown on a map alongside their active route and their next navigation instruction. Operators know where the client is heading and where they are.

items.title: User list with live status
items.body: A full list of the organisation's registered users, filterable by status: In Route, Awaits Call, In Call, Idle, Offline. Operators can see their whole queue at a glance.

items.title: AI chat history
items.body: The full conversation between the client and the Tiera AI assistant is visible to the operator during the call, providing context on what the client has already tried.

items.title: Call records and audit trail
items.body: Every call is logged with the operator's name, the client's name, start time, duration, and outcome. The records are available to organisation admins for reporting and quality assurance.

options.title: Your own operators
options.body: Train members of your team to use the Pathway dashboard. They sign in once per shift and handle calls from your registered clients only. Pathway access is included in Organisation, Local Authority, and Enterprise plans. You control staffing, hours, and coverage.
options.best_for: Charities and local authorities with existing support staff

options.title: Touchpulse managed operators
options.body: Purchase managed staffing from Touchpulse. Our trained operators cover your clients using the Pathway dashboard. Billed on actual usage with transparent in-app tracking. Choose a prepaid bundle for the best rate: Starter 1,000 min per year, Standard 3,000 min per year, or Enterprise 6,000 plus min per year.
options.best_for: Organisations without dedicated support staff or those scaling quickly

sections.note: Pay-as-you-go is available for organisations with variable or unpredictable usage. All bundles include full Pathway platform access.

sections.heading: Calls stay within your organisation
sections.body: Teleassistance calls are authenticated against the client's organisation. Your operators only receive calls from your registered clients. Touchpulse managed operators are licensed to specific geographic regions. Clients in queue are matched to an operator licensed for their area.

sections.heading: See Pathway in action
sections.body: Book a demo and we will walk you through a live call: from the client pressing the button to the operator hanging up and navigation resuming.

seo.title: Tiera: the navigation app your clients carry | Touchpulse
seo.description: Tiera is the AI navigation app for blind and low-vision users. Voice-first, 20 languages, built for independence from the ground up. Included free for every client of a Touchpulse partner organisation.

sections.headline: The app your clients carry
sections.subheadline: Tiera is the AI navigation companion built for blind and low-vision users from the ground up. Voice-first, 20 languages, and deeply connected to your ROVI dashboard. Included free for every client your organisation registers.
sections.image_alt: First-person perspective of a person crossing a street with Tiera

sections.body: The name comes from a variant of Tierra, from the Latin terra, meaning earth, land, or ground. It symbolises being grounded, stable, and connected to the world around you. That is the mission: to help people move through their environment with confidence.

sections.heading: Built for this, not retrofitted for this
sections.intro: Tiera is not a standard navigation app with an accessibility setting bolted on. Every decision, from the first screen to the last instruction, was made with blind and low-vision users in front of us.

items.title: Voice-first by design
items.body: Not a buried setting. Navigation, destination search, and assistant commands all work by voice from the home screen. The phone can stay in the user's pocket throughout.

items.title: 20 languages on day one
items.body: The UI, TTS, and autocomplete locale are all wired together. Tiera works natively in the user's language. Not just translated strings.

items.title: AI personalisation that remembers
items.body: Users type free-text instructions once: 'Ignore all trees and bushes', 'Always tell me about tactile pavement'. The assistant honours them on every future route, indefinitely.

items.title: Checkpoints: solving the standing-still problem
items.body: Every navigation app fails at the moment you exit a building with no idea which way is forward. Checkpoints fix it. Point the phone vertically. A vibration confirms you are facing the right direction. Walk on.

items.title: No silent re-planning
items.body: Going off-route triggers a calm audio cue and a single recovery step. Never a quiet route rewrite that leaves the user disoriented without explanation.

items.title: Street names on turn and on pass
items.body: Tiera announces street names when you turn and as you pass them, so users build a genuine mental map of their environment over time.

sections.heading: Connected to your ROVI dashboard
sections.body: When a trainer assigns a route in ROVI, the client receives a push notification in Tiera within seconds. A dedicated Custom Routes tab lists every assigned route with the trainer's organisation name, sorted by most recent. The client follows the trainer's exact path with their guidance spoken at the precise moments the trainer marked. This connection between trainer and client is what separates Tiera from any general-purpose navigation app.
sections.callout: Tiera is included free for every client of a Touchpulse partner organisation. No per-seat fee, no registration cost.

sections.heading: Human support, one tap away
sections.body: For organisations with Pathway enabled, a call button sits on the main navigation screen. The client can press it or say 'call teleassistance' mid-stride. The app confirms out loud, reads back the estimated wait time, and connects to a sighted operator. Navigation resumes exactly where it left off when the call ends.

items.title: Reachable by touch or voice
items.body: The button is large, prominently placed, and accessible without unlocking or navigating menus.

items.title: Minute balance always visible
items.body: Users with a managed minutes allocation can see their remaining balance in-app at any time. Minutes are deducted cheapest-first.

items.title: Only for your organisation's clients
items.body: The teleassistance button is only visible to users whose organisation has Pathway enabled. It is not available to the general public.

steps.title: Install and onboard
steps.body: Install from the App Store or Google Play. The onboarding walkthrough covers the layout, key buttons, and permissions. Microphone and location access are explained clearly at each step.

steps.title: Log in and sync settings
steps.body: Sign in with Google or Apple ID. Language and preferences sync automatically and restore on any device.

steps.title: Plan a route
steps.body: Type or speak a destination. Tiera plans the route and reads a summary aloud: destination, distance, and estimated travel time. Saved favourites can be launched with a single tap.

steps.title: Navigate confidently
steps.body: Instructions are given before and at each turn, including the street you are turning onto and side streets as you pass them. The phone stays in the pocket. The screen can be off throughout.

items.question: Why does Tiera need microphone and location access?
items.answer: The microphone powers the voice assistant so users can speak destinations and commands hands-free. Location is used for real-time navigation and to answer orientation queries like 'Where am I?'. The app tells you clearly whenever either is active.

items.question: Does Tiera work without an internet connection?
items.answer: No. Tiera requires a network connection. If connectivity is lost during navigation, a warning appears within seconds. The app blocks startup if there is no connection and prompts the user to reconnect.

items.question: Can clients use Bluetooth headphones?
items.answer: Yes. All audio, including navigation instructions, voice assistant responses, and Pathway calls, routes automatically to a connected Bluetooth earpiece.

items.question: How do clients save frequent addresses?
items.answer: Open the Favourites page and save any address. There is no limit on how many can be stored.

items.question: What is Checkpoints?
items.answer: Checkpoints is an orientation feature that uses the camera and haptic feedback to help users face the right direction at the start of a route, when they go off course, or on demand. It can be triggered manually or configured to activate automatically in Settings.

items.question: What does a Pathway operator see about the client?
items.answer: Operators can see the client's live camera feed, map position, active route, next navigation instruction, and AI chat history during a call. If the client has set up an accessibility profile, operators can see that too so they can tailor their assistance.

items.question: Is Tiera free for clients?
items.answer: Yes. Tiera is included free for every client registered by a Touchpulse partner organisation. There is no per-seat fee and no registration cost for clients.

items.question: How do clients submit feedback?
items.answer: Go to Settings and find the feedback button. Feedback is sent by email and a confirmation is sent once it is submitted.

seo.title: How Touchpulse works | The O&M support platform
seo.description: Touchpulse connects three tools into one platform for Orientation and Mobility support: ROVI for trainers, Pathway for operators, and Tiera for clients.

sections.headline: One platform, three connected tools
sections.subheadline: ROVI, Pathway, and Tiera are designed to work together. A route built in ROVI appears in Tiera within seconds. A client who needs help presses one button in Tiera and an operator in Pathway is with them in moments.

sections.heading: What a week looks like with Touchpulse

scenarios.title: Monday: a new client joins
scenarios.body: A trainer receives a referral for a client who needs to learn the route from home to their local supermarket. They open ROVI, type the two addresses, adjust two waypoints to avoid a road closure they know about, and add spoken instructions at three key decision points. They assign the route to the client in the same screen. The client's Tiera app pings within seconds.

scenarios.title: Wednesday: the client walks the route
scenarios.body: The client opens their Custom Routes tab, taps the assigned route, and starts walking. Tiera guides them turn by turn. At the second junction, the trainer's recorded instruction plays: 'Cross here, not at the lights ahead'. The trainer can see the breadcrumb trail live from their ROVI dashboard.

scenarios.title: Wednesday afternoon: the client gets confused
scenarios.body: A road is partially blocked by a delivery vehicle. The client taps the Pathway call button. An operator accepts within 20 seconds. They see the camera feed immediately: a large white van blocking the pavement. They talk the client around it in 45 seconds. Navigation resumes. The call is logged automatically.

scenarios.title: Friday: the trainer reviews the week
scenarios.body: The trainer checks the ROVI dashboard. Three clients walked routes this week. One completed the supermarket route twice. One deviated at the same point both times, suggesting a re-assessment of the instructions at that waypoint. The trainer updates the instruction before Monday.
